text:
Maya: quick ask — can we run a full perf sweep for dora-15b before EOW? need p50/p95, memory, and a tail-latency trace for seq=1024 and 2048. batch sweep: 1,2,4,8. prefer int8 and fp16 runs.
Tony: got it. do you want the `/profile` defaults or the new kernel-tuning flags enabled?
Maya: enable kernel-tuning + kv-cache warmup. also capture per-layer time breakdown if possible.
Anika: I can kick off the jobs in eu-west-1 Dedicated pool tonight. which concurrency limit should I apply?
Maya: start with cap=4 per-GPU. if we see degredation bump to 8. keep a note for traceback windows.
Jason: tagging infra — @infra-bot can you reserve 4 gpus in ded-eu-west for 2 hours starting 22:00 UTC?
infra-bot: reservation created: ded-eu-west | 4xA100: start=1763512800 end=1763519600 | ticket=INF-4521
Evan: I'll add a quick smoke script to validate output parity vs baseline (lyra-13b) — nothing fancy, just 50 prompts.
Kira: reminder: please include perf config used and prompt-set id in the bench summary. use promptset: onboarding/dora/ps-v1.
Tony: starting int8 runs now. command:```bash
profile --model dora-15b --quant int8 --seq 1024,2048 --batch 1,2,4,8 --warmup 100 --kernels tune --out /tmp/dora-int8.json
```
Tony: first pass looks okay, p95 ~ 210ms for seq=1024 batch=1 (per-token). memory stable, KV hit rate 0.98. saving traces.
bench-bot: run-complete: dora-15b int8 | seq=1024 | batch=1 | p50=120ms p95=210ms mem=22.4GB trace=/artifacts/1763502000/int8/seq1024_b1.trace
Maya: nice. can you start fp16 sweep after int8 finishes?
Tony: queuing fp16. ETA ~ 18m.
Anika: logs show one OOM on batch=8 seq=2048 in int8 — looks like config missing `kv_cache_shrink` flag. filing small bug: RUNTIME-773.
Jason: thanks, Anika. can we repro locally with `--heap-check` before re-run?
Anika: yes, repro locally. patch pushed to branch `runtime/kv-shrink-fix`, will roll to bench runner in 10m.
Tony: fp16 results in: p50=95ms p95=180ms seq=1024 batch=1 mem=28.1GB. no OOMs.
bench-bot: run-complete: dora-15b fp16 | seq=1024 | batch=1 | p50=95ms p95=180ms mem=28.1GB report=/artifacts/1763502000/fp16/seq1024_b1.json
Maya: please compile a concise summary in this thread once you have the artifacts. include the regression checks vs lyra-13b and the parity smoke results.
Evan: smoke pass done — outputs match baseline for 47/50 prompts. 3 diffs are minor punctuation. added diff.zip to artifacts.
Maya: thanks everyone. plan: publish bench summary to shared drive tomorrow AM, and tag model as "onboard-ready: perf-validated" if no new issues.
Tony: ack. I'll post the full artifact links + perf charts here when all suites finish. :rocket: 
Maya: closing loop — if anyone sees a spike in tail latency in the next 24h ping here.
Jason: noted.
Anika: leaving the job running for batch=8 seq=2048 (after fix). will update results here.
bench-bot: run-complete: dora-15b int8 | seq=2048 | batch=8 | p50=450ms p95=980ms mem=45.7GB trace=/artifacts/1763502000/int8/seq2048_b8.trace
Maya: ok rough but expected for seq=2048. add a note: recommend lowering max-batch for long-seq in policy.
Tony: adding that to rollout config: `max_batch_long_seq=2` in canary policy.
Maya: perfect. thanks all — will check back tomorrow after you post the summary.
